ir.name: pairwise_advantage_entropy_covariance_reg_repair
ir.intuition: Fix missing entropy keys by falling back to zeros, preserve original regularizer and loss structure
ir.pseudocode:
x = clamp(alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + beta * advantage_gap, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
base_loss = sum(weighted_loss) / (sum(weight) + eps)
entropy = entropy_w * entropy_l (or zeros)
entropy_mean = sum(weight * entropy) / (sum(weight) + eps)
adv_mean = sum(weight * advantage_gap) / (sum(weight) + eps)
entropy_diff = entropy - entropy_mean
adv_diff = advantage_gap - adv_mean
covariance = sum(weight * entropy_diff * adv_diff) / (sum(weight) + eps)
entropy_adv_reg = entropy_coeff * abs(covariance)
final_loss = base_loss + entropy_adv_reg
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-12
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    advantage_gap = batch["advantage_gap"]

    entropy_w = batch.get("entropy_w", lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape))
    entropy_l = batch.get("entropy_l", lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape))

    alpha = float(extra.get("alpha", extra.get("hyperparams", {}).get("alpha", 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get("beta", extra.get("hyperparams", {}).get("beta", 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get("hyperparams", {}).get("scale", 2.0))
    entropy_coeff = float(extra.get("entropy_coeff", 0.01))

    x = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap))
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    weighted_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    base_loss = ops.div(weighted_sum, ops.add(weight_sum, eps))

    entropy = ops.mul(entropy_w, entropy_l)
    weighted_entropy_sum = ops.sum(ops.mul(entropy, weight))
    weighted_adv_sum = ops.sum(ops.mul(advantage_gap, weight))

    entropy_mean = ops.div(weighted_entropy_sum, ops.add(weight_sum, eps))
    adv_mean = ops.div(weighted_adv_sum, ops.add(weight_sum, eps))

    entropy_diff = ops.sub(entropy, entropy_mean)
    adv_diff = ops.sub(advantage_gap, adv_mean)

    cov = ops.div(
        ops.sum(ops.mul(ops.mul(entropy_diff, adv_diff), weight)),
        ops.add(weight_sum, eps))

    entropy_adv_reg = ops.mul(entropy_coeff, ops.abs(cov))

    final_loss = ops.add(base_loss, entropy_adv_reg)
    return final_loss
